# `aitbc agent-comm discover`

Discover active agents on a specific chain by chain ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm discover [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--capabilities` | text | — | no | Required capabilities (comma-separated) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm discover --chain-id <chain_id>
```
